follow-up time: Until birth and current health status for children
cohort: 13 patients diagnosed with cervical cancer during pregnancy between January 2010 and December 2021
finding: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by cesarean radical hysterectomy appears to be safe and effective for the treatment of cervical cancer during pregnancy, with acceptable maternal, obstetric, and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean radical hysterectomy was performed in 11/13 patients following neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with no major complications.
